T:P1.1.text: RMR Group | Leading U.S. CRE Investment Manager

T:P1.2.text: For 40 years, RMR has combined institutional discipline with entrepreneurial agility to unlock opportunity across all major real estate sectors.

T:P1.3.text: How Sun Belt renters are navigating choice, technology and uncertainty

T:P1.4.text: Industrial Demand in the Data Center Economy

T:P1.5.text: Industrial assets adjacent to data center corridors are showing stronger fundamentals, stickier tenants and longer economic lives than the broader market - and they capture that upside without ever becoming data centers themselves.

T:P1.6.text: Defining the Collateral Advantage in Private CRE Credit

T:P1.7.text: Tom Lorenzini and Jared Lewis discuss how private CRE credit offers distinct collateral advantages and downside protection.

T:P1.8.text: Potential isn’t patient. It unfolds where strategy and execution meet.

T:P1.9.text: For nearly four decades, we’ve operated at the intersection of insight and execution: identifying opportunity early, acting with precision and delivering results through cycles. We combine the scale of an institutional platform with the agility of an operator, partnering closely with investors, tenants and stakeholders to create long-term value. Our diversified model spans property management, asset management, capital formation, development and strategic operations, designed to anticipate market needs and respond decisively. Our platform brings insight, experience and execution together across ...

T:P1.10.text: We don’t just react to the market. We anticipate it. Through data, experience and instinct, we identify opportunity before it’s obvious. Explore some of our projects currently in motion.

T:P1.11.text: Master plan of eclectic new neighborhood spanning 18 acres designed to transform Nashville's East Bank and connect to Downtown.

T:P1.12.text: Located just one mile from the University of North Carolina Wilmington, the 8.6‑acre, shovel‑ready site will be transformed from a vacant AMC theater into a fully amenitized, modern housing option designed to meet strong and growing demand from upperclassmen and graduate students.

T:P1.13.text: High-impact repositioning in the heart of Foggy Bottom.

T:P1.14.text: Delivering a modern residential community paired with ground‑floor retail; expanding an already successful adaptive‑reuse campus into a vibrant mixed‑use destination.

T:P1.15.text: North Station Gateway: Landmark Mixed-Use Development

T:P1.16.text: Designed to serve as a true gateway between downtown Boston and its northern neighborhoods, the North Station Gateway project will introduce new residential, hospitality and retail offerings to one of the city’s most dynamic and rapidly evolving districts.

T:P1.18.text: Transforming an obsolete office park into a vibrant, transit-oriented multifamily community.

T:P1.19.text: The best partnerships don’t just manage capital. They create new chapters of growth.

T:P1.20.text: We believe the strongest partnerships aren’t transactional. They’re transformational. That’s why we invest alongside our clients, share their risk and work relentlessly to make them look brilliant. With the scale of a national platform and the service culture of a boutique firm, we turn partnership into a lasting strategic advantage.

C:S1.1.text: Its website says it owns, operates, and invests in real estate through its balance sheet and through its investment management platform.

C:S2.1.text: It runs two intertwined businesses: a principal investment platform that co-invests in direct real estate and credit, and a fee-generating property services arm that manages assets for institutional third parties and the firm's own ventures.

C:S3.1.text: Investment activities in the Consolidated Portfolio involve ownership of multifamily units, office, and retail space and one hotel.

C:S4.1.text: Its co-investment side places its own capital alongside outside investors in property and credit, and its investment management side earns fees by running vehicles for third parties.
